describes: A repo whose CI runs on GitHub Actions and deploys through GitHub Deployments: a recipe that waits on the PR checks, and a landing that waits for the deployment status of the merge.

recipes.name: the PR checks on GitHub Actions
recipes.note: waits on the branch PR checks through gh; push first. For every increment, a spec check of kind ci does the same

steps.wait: s=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/deployments?sha=$MERGE_SHA&environment=production&per_page=1" --jq '.[0].statuses_url // empty' 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$s" ] && gh api "$s" --jq '[.[] | select(.state=="success")][0].environment_url // empty' 2>/dev/null
steps.note: prints nothing until a production deployment of the merge reports success; stderr is discarded so an auth error is never read as a URL
the deployment answers at its URL
